premise: Everyone in this world is born with magic. I'm the only one ever born without any. But magic doesn't work on me either.

draft.premise: Everyone in this world is born with magic. I'm the only one ever born without any. But magic doesn't work on me either.

world.title: Untouchable
world.era: A high-medieval fantasy era: magical hearths, crystal lanterns, and floating skyships powered by mana.

extraordinary.reach: Casting spells to manipulate elements, heal wounds, or power machines, up to bending space itself.

rules.text: Every living human is born with a mana core and can cast spells, except for the rare anomaly.
Magic has no effect on a person who does not possess a mana core.
Mana can be stored in physical crystals to power machines, skyships, and cities.

peoples.name: Human
peoples.culture: A society deeply divided by magical aptitude and lineage, where spellcasting is the measure of worth.

creatures.name: Mana Beast
creatures.description: Wild animals whose bodies have been warped and empowered by ambient mana.
creatures.habitat: The wild forests beyond the city walls

rungs.name: Apprentice
rungs.description: Can spark small flames or move light objects.

rungs.name: Journeyman
rungs.description: Capable of sustained casting and basic elemental manipulation.

rungs.name: Mage
rungs.description: Highly skilled, able to power major machinery or fight in battles.

rungs.name: Archmage
rungs.description: A master of the craft, capable of altering local weather or gravity.

travel.description: People travel by foot, horse-drawn carts, or luxurious mana-powered skyships.

medicine.healing: Magical mending can knit flesh instantly, while mundane herbs are used for the magicless.

laws.text: Only licensed mages are permitted to cast spells within the city limits of Lumina.

places.name: Lumina Academy
places.description: The grand spires of the empire's premiere institution for magical learning.

places.name: Academy Gardens
places.description: Meticulously manicured lawns and magical floating flora surrounding the academy.

places.name: Low Town
places.description: The dense, soot-choked slums at the base of the academy's floating island.

factions.name: The Archmage Council
factions.description: The ruling body of Lumina, comprised of the most powerful spellcasters in the land.

factions.name: House Valerius
factions.description: An ancient noble family famous for producing high-tier elemental mages.

npcs.name: Lord Valerius
npcs.description: A stern, prideful noble who views his magicless child as a stain on the family honor.

wants: to preserve the family reputation at any cost

npcs.name: Lyra Valerius
npcs.description: Your younger sister, a prodigy in wind magic who is torn between family loyalty and her love for you.

wants: to protect you from their father's wrath

npcs.name: Headmaster Vane
npcs.description: The enigmatic ruler of Lumina Academy, always searching for anomalies in the flow of magic.

wants: to understand the source of your magic immunity

clocks.name: The Banishing Decree
steps: The Council begins debating your presence in Lumina.
The Council drafts the exile order.
Lord Valerius signs the family's disownment papers.
The City Watch is dispatched to escort you to the edge of the floating island.

threads.title: Avoid exile from Lumina
threads.stakes: Being cast out to the dangerous wilderness below the floating island.

mysteries.question: Why was I born without magic, yet immune to it?
mysteries.answer: The player is a descendant of the ancient Null Lineage, which possessed no internal mana but possessed a soul that actively grounds and disperses mana around them.
clues: Ancient texts in the Academy's restricted library mentioning the Grounders.
Your mother's old locket, which is made of anti-magic iron.
A strange birthmark on your shoulder that pulses whenever high-tier spells are cast near you.

known_facts: You are the only person in Lumina born without a drop of magic.
Spells thrown directly at you simply dissolve into nothingness.
Your father, Lord Valerius, is deeply ashamed of your condition.

opening.situation: At the center of the Lumina Academy courtyard, your father commands a spell of fire to strike you, only for the sparks to vanish into thin air upon touching your skin.

world.summary: You are the only person in a highly magical society born without any magic. Yet, your complete lack of mana makes you entirely immune to all spellcasting, a dangerous anomaly that has drawn the suspicious eyes of the ruling Council.

character.name: Karen
character.description: A focused, resilient youth with watchful eyes, carrying the quiet confidence of someone who has had to rely entirely on their own physical limits.
character.appearance: Athletic build, short dark hair, wearing a simple leather training vest and trousers that contrast with the ornate robes of the academy students.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.notes: Years of physical training to compensate for a lack of magic.

skills.name: Melee Combat
skills.notes: Proficient in basic hand-to-hand and sword techniques.

skills.name: Observation
skills.notes: You have learned to watch a mage's hands and focus to predict their spells.

traits.name: Iron Will
traits.description: Resistant to fear and psychological pressure, hardened by years of being an outcast.

traits.name: Magically Blind
traits.description: You cannot sense ambient mana or see invisible magical constructs with the naked eye.

talents.name: Null Body
talents.covers: any physical training or martial move you attempt to master
talents.reason: Because your body is completely free of mana, your muscles, reflexes, and physical senses adapt to physical training at an unnatural speed.

powers.name: Absolute Magic Immunity
powers.description: Your lack of a mana core prevents spells from interacting with or affecting your body in any way.
limits: Does not protect against indirect magical physical hazards, like a magically thrown boulder or a collapsing ceiling.

fears: being completely helpless in a physical trap

items.name: Steel Dagger
items.description: A well-balanced steel blade, entirely un-enchanted.

items.name: Practice Wooden Sword
items.description: Chipped and worn from thousands of swings.

connections.name: Sister Lyra
connections.note: The only member of your family who still shows you genuine warmth.
